pages.title: Crystal Bow
pages.text: Abyss crystal shards bound to a Luna wood grip turn this bow into a lance of light. Its arrows fly 25 percent farther than those of a common bow and strike for 1 more damage, and with 576 uses it lasts half again as long. It takes the same enchantments as any bow.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Two Abyss Crystal Shards as the limbs, a Luna Stick as the grip and three strings. Luna Sticks will not make a common bow.
